evidence: The composition of the deposited films was measured by X-ray photoelectron spectroscopy (XPS) and Rutherford backscattering spectroscopy (RBS). Surface roughness was measured with atomic force microscopy (AFM). X-ray diffraction (XRD) was applied to determine the crystalline structure of the barrier films. The sheet resistance of the grown barrier films was measured with the four-point probe method. The hydrogen content in the films was determined with elastic recoil detection (ERD).
